common.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

https.title: Warning: this connection is not secure
https.intro: This instance is reached over plain HTTP. Until HTTPS is set up, these do not work:
https.calls: Voice and video calls, and screen sharing

connect.title: Connect to an instance
connect.intro: Enter the address of the Nexus Chat instance you want to use.
connect.invalid: Enter an address such as chat.example.com.
connect.unreachable: No Nexus Chat instance answered at this address.

login.title: Log in to {{instance}}
login.invalidCredentials: The username or password is wrong.
login.delayed: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be used.
login.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys need HTTPS and a browser that supports them.
login.providerFailed: Signing in with the provider did not work. Try again.
login.providerNoAccount: No account is linked to this login. Log in another way and link the provider in settings.
login.providerNoEmail: The provider did not share your email address, which an account needs.
login.providerEmailInUse: An account already uses this email. Log in to it and link the provider in settings.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
mfa.invalid: That code did not work. Log in again to get a new attempt.

register.title: Create an account
register.closed: This instance is not accepting new accounts.
register.inviteRequired: This instance is invite-only. Enter an invite code.
register.invalidInvite: That invite code is unknown, used up or expired.

setup.title: Set up {{instance}}
setup.intro: Create the first admin account. The setup token is printed in the server's logs.
setup.httpWarning: Warning: the setup token and your password will travel unencrypted. Finish setup from the same machine or local network, or add HTTPS first.
setup.domainHint: Optional for now, needed for HTTPS and federation. For example chat.example.com
setup.invalidToken: That setup token is wrong. Copy it again from the server logs.
setup.alreadyComplete: This instance is already set up. Log in instead.
setup.done: Setup is complete. Log in with your new admin account.

home.title: Welcome, {{name}}
home.intro: You are logged in to {{instance}}. Servers and messages arrive in the next releases.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.intro: Settings for the whole instance. Only instance admins see this page.

tls.title: HTTPS certificate
tls.active: HTTPS is on, with this certificate:
tls.inactive: No certificate is installed, so this server does not serve HTTPS itself.
tls.proxyNote: If a reverse proxy (Caddy, Nginx, Traefik) handles HTTPS for this instance, you do not need a certificate here.
tls.expiresSoon_one: Warning: the certificate expires in {{count}} day
tls.expiresSoon_other: Warning: the certificate expires in {{count}} days
tls.expiresVerySoon_one: Warning: the certificate expires in {{count}} day. Replace it now.
tls.expiresVerySoon_other: Warning: the certificate expires in {{count}} days. Replace it now.
tls.replace: Once it expires, apps and browsers refuse to connect. Install the renewed certificate below; it takes effect without a restart.
tls.certificateHint: The certificate first, then every intermediate certificate, as one block of text.
tls.privateKeyHint: The key of the certificate above. It is cleared from this page once it is saved.
tls.installed: The certificate is installed and HTTPS is on.
tls.removeExplained: Removing the certificate turns HTTPS off. Plain HTTP keeps working, but calls, passkeys, encryption in browsers, push notifications, the mobile apps and federation stop working.
tls.removed: The certificate is removed and HTTPS is off.

smtp.title: Email (SMTP)
smtp.intro: The mail server this instance sends verification, password reset and warning emails through.
smtp.none: None (only for a relay on the same network)
smtp.passwordKept: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
smtp.passwordOptional: Leave empty if the mail server needs no sign-in.
smtp.testSent: The test email was sent to your address.
smtp.notConfigured: Save the email settings before sending a test email.
smtp.deliveryFailed: The mail server did not accept the test email. Check the settings and try again.
smtp.testRateLimited: Too many test emails. Wait a minute and try again.
